purpose: Basel Standardized Measurement Approach (SMA) for operational-risk capital per the July 2026 US Basel Endgame reproposal (comment period closed 2026-06-18, final expected ~Q4 2026): marginal Business Indicator Component across the $1bn/$30bn buckets (12%/15%/18%) and the Internal Loss Multiplier, applying the reproposal's US-variant ILM neutralization to 1 by default with a switch to model the non-neutralized BCBS d424 formula. rule_status: proposed -- re-pin at finalization. Formula-focused; does not model scenario/portfolio replay (see the SIM-REPLAY suite for that).
